title: Past Simple: Building Sentences
description: Form past tense sentences with regular and irregular verbs and time expressions like yesterday, last night and ago.

thumbnail.alt: An antique polaroid camera and aged photo prints on a wooden scrapbook table
thumbnail.prompt: An antique polaroid camera and aged photo prints on a wooden scrapbook table. Flat vector illustration, soft warm earthy palette (terracotta, sage green, ochre, muted blue, cream) with a small touch of muted gold, very subtle, even paper grain, simple rounded shapes, gentle soft lighting, centered composition with generous empty space around the subject, mid-tone background that works on both dark and light pages. items.sentence: I went to the supermarket yesterday.
alternatives: Yesterday I went to the supermarket.
items.hint: Time expressions can go at the end or at the beginning.

items.sentence: She did not watch TV last night.
alternatives: Last night she did not watch TV.
items.translation: Ela não assistiu TV ontem à noite.

items.sentence: They played soccer in the afternoon.
alternatives: In the afternoon they played soccer.

items.sentence: We had a wonderful picnic by the lake.
items.translation: Nós fizemos um piquenique maravilhoso perto do lago.

items.sentence: He bought a new bicycle two weeks ago.
items.translation: Ele comprou uma bicicleta nova duas semanas atrás.

items.sentence: Did you see that interesting movie?
Last year my family traveled to London.
alternatives: My family traveled to London last year.
items.translation: No ano passado minha família viajou para Londres.
